answer: At the peeling shed the willow peeler draws each rod through the brake and watches the bark come away clean. Cane wicker basket mender hurdle warrant is the watching: a warrant wicker basket menders show after mending bench trials. The anchor is the first rod peeled, the ivory the last before the basket fills, and the haven is the basket, heaped with pale rods. A cheat must peel 31 false rods and fill 31 false baskets.
